core_question: How do I stop a shoe from squeaking when I walk? (secondary: How do you break in a new pair of hiking boots so they don't cause blisters on a long hike?)
answer_summary: Lift the insole (or work powder in around its edges) and sprinkle talcum/baby powder between the insole and outsole to reduce the friction causing the squeak.; after the topic shift: Wear the new boots around the house and on progressively longer short walks before the trip to soften them and identify pressure points, applying moleskin or blister tape to any hot spots.
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; chatty and verbose
